summary: Iran conducted multiple missile launches from Hamadan, Shiraz, and Tehran while a severe explosion near the Ashura Garrison in Isfahan caused power and cellular outages. Israeli forces carried out air strikes and drone attacks across southern Lebanon, including Zoutar al-Sharqiyah, Nabatieh al-Fawqa, Shukin, and Khiam, and completed a tunnel demolition operation in central Gaza. US CENTCOM Commander Adm. Brad Cooper met Israeli military leadership in Tel Aviv amid Western assessments of increased likelihood of large-scale US strikes on Iran.
key_points: Iran launched missiles from Hamadan at 13:34 local time and from Shiraz at 0628Z, plus a test launch from Lashkarak, Tehran. (Source: @shin_persian/12588, @shin_persian/12584, @shin_persian/12578)
Severe explosion near Ashura Garrison in Najafabad, Isfahan caused power and cellular outage. (Source: @shin_persian/12591)
Israeli air strikes hit Zoutar al-Sharqiyah, Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/53895)
Israeli drone exploded on residential roof in Nabatieh al-Fawqa; another dropped sound bomb there. (Source: @redlinkleb/53944, @redlinkleb/53943)
IDF completed tunnel demolition beyond Yellow Line in central Gaza (Bureij, Nuseirat); Salah a-Din road reopened. (Source: @manniefabian/59556)
US CENTCOM Commander Adm. Brad Cooper met IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir and Mossad head in Israel. (Source: @manniefabian/59551)
Western officials assess increased likelihood of large-scale US strikes on Iran. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10229)
Iraqi security reforms: force at Jurf al-Sakhar replaced, Energy Police assigned to pipeline, smuggling files to judiciary. (Source: @shin_persian/12586)

points: Missile launch detected from Hamadan at 13:34 local (1004Z), Hamadan Province, per delayed monitoring feed. (Source: @shin_persian/12588)
Two missiles launched from Shiraz at 0628Z, Fars Province, recorded by FromIran tracking. (Source: @shin_persian/12584)

Missile test launch from Lashkarak at 0718Z, Tehran Province. (Source: @shin_persian/12578)
AiA activity reported in Ramhormoz at 0828Z, Khuzestan Province. (Source: @shin_persian/12572)

Western officials say likelihood of renewed large-scale US strikes on Iran has increased as military clashes escalate. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10229)

US CENTCOM Commander Adm. Brad Cooper met IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir and Mossad head Roman Gofman at Kirya; joint situation assessment included heads of Operations, Planning, Intelligence, Air Force. (Source: @amitsegal/67382, @manniefabian/59551)
